subject: Weeklies: Strategy sync — wins, blockers, and QBR prep
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Denise Park <denise@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weeklies: Strategy sync — wins, blockers, and QBR prep

Team,

Quick leadership update with the bits I want surfaced before Friday's prep session. TL;DR — momentum on Hosted API adoption, one procurement slip for a major prospect, and a small but material compliance ask for Private deployments.

Wins
- Hosted API: 18% week-over-week growth in API keys with production traffic (driven by two fintech pilots). Observability shows median gen latency stable at 48ms for 512-token profiles.
- Optimize: internal rollout of intelligent batching reduced per-token compute cost on our large-model profiles by ~11% in the pilot cluster.
- CS/Success: two customers moved to Dedicated trial — good signals for Q2 expansion.

Risks / Blockers- Acme Corp (large prospect) requested SOC 2 Type II evidence + VPC network diagrams; procurement timeline slipped by ~2 weeks after legal review. Denise is cc'd — I'm coordinating.
- Private deployment: one on-prem pilot flagged HSM integration questions — this could delay their internal sign-off if we don’t provide a short remediation plan. Ethan, can your team provide an estimated ETA for HSM playbook?
- Model-run SLOs: edge-case latency regressions seen at high concurrency during the batching pilot; not blocking production but needs an ops mitigation plan.

Asks (before Friday QBR prep meeting)
1) All: please add one slide to the Q2 exec deck (attached draft) that answers: What changed since last week? One metric, one risk, one ask. Deadline: Thursday EOD.
2) Ethan: short bullet ETA for HSM integration playbook (can be a single email reply).
3) Rachel: legal to confirm whether the SOC 2 excerpt we plan to send is redline-safe for Acme — flagged in the shared doc.
4) Markus/Maya: quick note on whether we should surface the batching regressions in the QBR (yes/no + suggested mitigation).

Attachments: Q2_exec_slide_draft.pdf (slide placeholders), risk_register_qbr.xlsx (current risks list). Google doc link with speaker notes in related_links above.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weeklies: Strategy sync — wins, blockers, and QBR prep

Nice summary — thanks Tessa. Two quick items:

1) On Hosted API momentum: can you add the conversion rate (signup -> paid key) for the two fintech pilots in the slide? That helps the revenue callout.
2) On latency regressions: flag it in the deck but mark as mitigated if Ethan's team can confirm a short-term knob (e.g., temporary concurrency cap + cache warmers).

I’ll be at the prep session Friday.

Laura
COO, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weeklies: Strategy sync — wins, blockers, and QBR prep

Agree with surfacing the batching regression — here's what I'd like included so the execs have context:
- One-slide bullet: "Root cause: concurrency contention in continuous batching for long-sequence workloads; fallback path triggers doubled tokenization cost at peaks."
- Short-term mitigation: temporary concurrency cap + enable prefix KV caching for affected routes; ops smoke test scheduled for Thu 16:00 PT.
- Long-term: queue-based backpressure and smarter kernel selection — roadmap item for Q3.

Tessa — I can add a tiny architecture callout (one box diagram) to the slide. Ethan, please confirm the ETA for the smoke test and whether we need any support from infra on cluster configs.

-Markus
Head of Serving Runtime
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weeklies: Strategy sync — wins, blockers, and QBR prep

Thanks, all — quick callouts and next steps I’ll own: 
- I will update the slide deck with the fintech conversion metric (Laura) and include Markus’ single-box architecture callout.
- Ethan: if you can confirm the smoke-test result by Thu 17:00 PT, I will mark the latency regression as "mitigated (ops test passing)" in the QBR notes.
- Rachel: please advise on the SOC 2 excerpt by Thu EOD; if we can’t, I’ll propose a short customer-facing acknowledgment and a 2-week follow-up date for the full packet.

I’ll circulate the revised deck by Fri 09:00 for review. Jonas — want to call out any sales signals on Acme in the prep session? If so, send me a 2-sentence update.

Appreciate the quick turn — this will keep the QBR focused.

Tessa
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
